data.notes: December’s confirmed New York calendar already mixes arena-scale pop/R&B, LCD Soundsystem’s annual NYC residency, and Brooklyn’s house/techno/Latin club circuit, with more late-month underground announcements likely to follow.

events.title: LCD Soundsystem — NYC 2026 Residency
events.summary: LCD Soundsystem continues its NYC residency at Brooklyn Steel on December 1, one of several December dates in the band’s annual hometown run.

events.title: Doja Cat — Tour Ma Vie World Tour
events.summary: Doja Cat brings the Tour Ma Vie World Tour to Madison Square Garden with special guest Latto on December 1.

events.title: Brent Faiyaz Live: I Spent The Night With Brent Faiyaz
events.summary: Brent Faiyaz headlines Barclays Center on December 3 for his I Spent The Night With Brent Faiyaz arena show.

events.title: Bonobo (DJ Set)
events.summary: Bonobo plays a DJ set at Knockdown Center on December 5, with Anish Kumar also on the bill.

events.title: ReSolute presents: Kerri Chandler
events.summary: Long-running underground promoter ReSolute presents deep-house figurehead Kerri Chandler at a secret NYC location, with more artists to be announced.

events.title: Wang Leehom — The Best Place II World Tour
events.summary: Wang Leehom brings The Best Place II World Tour to Barclays Center on December 12.

events.title: ZERO Presents: NYE
events.summary: ZERO presents a New Year’s Eve house and indie-dance event at a secret Brooklyn location on December 31.

events.title: MUSCLECARS, Toribio, Love Injection: Together Again
events.summary: MUSCLECARS, Toribio and Love Injection reunite at H0L0 for a late-morning house and deep-house session hosted by Benny Soto, Nervous and danceherenow.

events.title: House of Grooves: Eli Escobar All Night + Sissies of Mercy
events.summary: House of Yes hosts Eli Escobar’s monthly House of Grooves residency on December 4, with Eli Escobar playing all night and Sissies of Mercy in the Onyx Room.

events.title: Joé Dwèt Filé
events.summary: French-Caribbean R&B artist Joé Dwèt Filé comes to Barclays Center on December 19.

events.title: Glitterbox: Inner City and More TBA
events.summary: International house and disco party brand Glitterbox returns to NYC at House of Yes with Detroit dance-music icons Inner City and more acts to be announced.

events.title: Laylit
events.summary: Laylit brings its Arab/SWANA diaspora-focused dance party to Elsewhere on December 4, with the lineup listed as to be announced.

events.title: AGAPĒ presents: Serafina - All Night Long
events.summary: AGAPĒ hosts Berlin-based Serafina for an open-to-close, high-BPM techno warehouse night at a Brooklyn location announced to ticket holders.

events.title: Elsewhere New Year’s Eve: San Pacho + more TBA
events.summary: Elsewhere’s New Year’s Eve party on December 31 is led by San Pacho in the Hall, with more artists to be announced.

events.title: Pablo Fierro w. Luna Mar, ASMOT & Kassin
events.summary: GRAY-AREA brings Pablo Fierro to Unveiled for an Afro-house session with Luna Mar, ASMOT and Kassin, connecting Afro-house, deep house, Latin rhythms and soulful club music.

events.title: Golden Record NYC presents Traumer All Night Long
events.summary: Golden Record brings French house and tech-house selector Traumer to a secret East Williamsburg location for a late-running all-night session.

events.title: Snow Ball: Eelke Kleijn Live!
events.summary: House of Yes stages its Snow Ball on December 5, headlined by melodic house artist Eelke Kleijn with additional artists to be announced.

events.title: MVSON Showcase w. Special Guests
events.summary: Manchester-born event series and label MVSON, founded by Mason Collective, takes over Brooklyn warehouse space 99 Scott for its New York showcase.

events.title: Renée Fleming and Béla Fleck
events.venueName: Stern Auditorium / Perelman Stage at Carnegie Hall
events.summary: Renée Fleming and Béla Fleck perform together at Carnegie Hall, pairing voice and banjo in a high-profile concert setting.

events.title: Leslie Odom Jr. Holiday Concert
events.venueName: Stern Auditorium / Perelman Stage at Carnegie Hall
events.summary: Tony- and Grammy-winning performer Leslie Odom Jr. is listed for a December 7 Carnegie Hall concert during the holiday season.

events.title: New York Philharmonic — Sound On: Steve Reich at 90
events.venueName: David Geffen Hall at Lincoln Center
events.summary: The New York Philharmonic marks Steve Reich’s 90th birthday in its Sound On contemporary music series, with David Robertson and Synergy Vocals joining for a program including Reich’s Tehillim.

events.title: GWAR — Gor Gor Must Die Tour
events.summary: GWAR brings the Gor Gor Must Die Tour to Palladium Times Square with Midnight, Mac Sabbath, and X-Cops listed as special appearances.

events.title: An Evening with the Mountain Goats
events.venueName: Stern Auditorium / Perelman Stage at Carnegie Hall
events.summary: The Mountain Goats are confirmed for an “An Evening with” concert at Carnegie Hall on December 10.

events.title: Daniil Trifonov
events.venueName: Stern Auditorium / Perelman Stage at Carnegie Hall
events.summary: Pianist Daniil Trifonov is confirmed for a solo Carnegie Hall date on December 12.

events.title: Andrea Bocelli — Romanza 30th Anniversary World Tour
events.summary: Andrea Bocelli brings the Romanza 30th Anniversary World Tour to Madison Square Garden for two confirmed nights, December 16 and 17.

events.title: esperanza spalding — Carnegie Hall Perspectives
events.venueName: Judy & Arthur Zankel Hall at Carnegie Hall
events.summary: Five-time Grammy-winning bassist, singer, and composer esperanza spalding launches her Carnegie Hall Perspectives series with a Zankel Hall program featuring jazz artists and contemporary dance innovators from New York City.

events.title: The New York Pops — Sleigh Bells Ring
events.venueName: Stern Auditorium / Perelman Stage at Carnegie Hall
events.summary: The New York Pops continues its annual Carnegie Hall holiday celebration with Derek Klena and Lindsay Mendez in a program of classic carols and new holiday favorites.
